messages:
marco.partnerships: FYI — ACMECloud reseller POs are stuck: our marketplace portal showed successful submit but their EDI/855 confirmations never arrive. Procurement is refusing to release payment until ack is received. Can the deal desk triage?

sam.sales: ugh. which flow? is this the new field reseller flow we launched last week? @nina.partnerships can you confirm which integration? :grimacing: 

nina.partnerships: yes this is the field reseller flow (partner id FR-998). We rolled the connector change Friday night to support multiple invoice_payment_terms. Partner backend accepted 850 but we see timeouts when we call their EDI ack endpoint.

marco.partnerships: logs from partner gateway show HTTP 504 on our /ack endpoint. they claim they never received our 855. Might be a message routing mismatch — payloads include an extra vendor_alias element.

Tomas.eng-runtime: I dug into the connector; we added `vendor_alias` inside `PO/BuyerInfo` per the partner request. Their EDI parser is strict — it expects `PO/BuyerInfo/CompanyID` only. I can revert or add compatibility mapping. Patch will take ~2 hrs to deploy to marketplace staging, ~4 hrs to push to prod after approvals.

lina.legal: also flag: partner put back a sentence-level SLA indemnity clause in the contract addendum during onboarding. Our deal desk told them to remove it but legal hasn't signed the latest markup. Ashley, procurement needs a signed SOW to release funds right?

ashley.finance: correct — we need the signed addendum or a PO with explicit acceptance terms. Procurement is holding until EDI ack + signed paperwork. We can provisionally approve if partner provides an emailed attestation while infra fixes the connector.

marco.partnerships: thanks. two tracks then: infra fix to stop 504s, and legal to clear the addendum. Can we escalate to partner success to get a manual attestation today?

sam.sales: I'll ping the partner account lead now. cc @lina.legal — can you propose minimal safe language to accept temporary attestation?

lina.legal: propose: partner emails a one-paragraph attestation confirming acceptance of the PO terms for the current order and waiving the indemnity clause pending contract finalization. We need that email from a named signatory. I'll draft and share a short template in ~20m.

Tomas.eng-runtime: quick note on rollback plan: I can push a compatibility shim that maps `vendor_alias` -> `CompanyID` in the EDI envelope. The shim will be a runtime transform deployed to the marketplace gateway (no model/runtime touch). I'll do the deploy window at 11:30 PT if you confirm. It will add about 200ms to processing but should fix the ack flow.

marco.partnerships: 11:30 PT works. Sam/Nina please get partner attestation before then so procurement can move once acks start flowing.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: marketplace-gateway-transform v1.0 -> prod at 11:30 PT by tomas.eng-runtime. CI checks passed. 

sam.sales: Partner lead responded: "we can send attestation, will name CFO and reference PO# 989-PQ-443" — sending now.

ashley.finance: got the attestation email from partner. saving to the portal. procurement will tentatively release funds once we see the first 855 within the next hour.

Tomas.eng-runtime: shim live. watching logs.

devops-bot: deployment success: marketplace-gateway-transform v1.0 -> prod. duration 3m12s.

Tomas.eng-runtime: first 855 received for PO 989-PQ-443, partner acked with status ACCEPTED. forwarding to finance.

ashley.finance: confirmed receipt. procurement released the payment hold. closing the immediate blocker.

nina.partnerships: great work. follow-ups: 1) schedule an RFC to formalize EDI field contract (vendor_alias mapping) 2) product change to validate partner parser tolerances 3) legal to finalize addendum within 7 business days.

lina.legal: will finalize and get signatures in 5 business days. sharing draft now.

marco.partnerships: thanks everyone. I'll create a short postmortem and capture the temporary attestation + deploy timeline for audit. :+1:
